parameters.description: The key or element value to locate.

parameters.description: Optional hex salt. Will be randomly generated if not provided.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: The claims structure to sign.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: HMAC secret token key.

parameters.name: options.expiresIn
parameters.description: Expiration duration in seconds.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: The absolute or relative path to the database .json file.

ds/bloom-filter.name: bloom-filter

parameters.description: Array bit length allocation.

parameters.description: Total hashes to execute per item.

parameters.description: Maximum number of items allowed in the cache before eviction.

parameters.description: Item lifetime in milliseconds. 0 represents infinite lifespan.
